title: Matched published transductive baselines for CUB 200-way 1-shot
shared_features: L2-normalized concatenation of individually normalized frozen DINOv2-B/14 and DINOv2-L/14 CLS features

TIM_ADM.source: Boudiaf et al., NeurIPS 2020; official mboudiaf/TIM implementation

MAP_RAW.source: Hu et al. PT-MAP family without power transform

SIGNED_PT_MAP.source: Hu et al. PT-MAP adapted for signed DINO CLS features
SIGNED_PT_MAP.signed_transform: sign(x)*abs(x)^power because DINO CLS contains negative values

LAPLACIANSHOT.source: Ziko et al., ICML 2020; official imtiazziko/LaplacianShot implementation

primary_metric: mean query balanced accuracy across ten support rotations

paper_route_gate.competitive_gate: DCTPR is within 1.0 percentage point of the strongest published baseline averaged across the three episodes
paper_route_gate.breadth_gate: DCTPR exceeds at least two of TIM-ADM, MAP-RAW, signed PT-MAP, LaplacianShot, and LaplacianShot with prototype rectification
paper_route_gate.on_pass: continue to prior stress and frozen Stanford Dogs confirmation
paper_route_gate.on_fail: retain DCTPR only as an efficient simple baseline; do not claim superior method accuracy

interpretation_limits: The signed power transform is an explicit adaptation, not an official PT-MAP reproduction on ReLU features
LaplacianShot lambda may use Episode 1 labels but is frozen for Episodes 2/3 and the second dataset
No published baseline may read query labels during inference
